nom: Naked Sundays CabanaClear Water Gel Serum Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, oily/combination, or acne-prone skin generally report the formula absorbs quickly, does not feel greasy, and one calls it perfect for oily skin, though one reviewer explicitly wonders whether it suits oily skin and asks for feedback from that group.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-ish skin report it layers over hydration without pilling, though one dry/combination reviewer found it not as hydrating or moisturizing as she prefers and skin prep is recommended before wearing it alone.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with an oily T-zone and dry cheeks, describe it as balancing, hydrating enough to wear alone under makeup, and non-greasy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including some with rosacea, perioral dermatitis, or eye sensitivity) mostly report no stinging, irritation, or breakouts, but one sensitive-skin reviewer experienced burning on her face after several days of use.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin reports it works well under foundation and on the neck/chest without settling into fine lines and wrinkles.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer addressing mature/aging skin reports it does not enhance fine lines or wrinkles and wears well under foundation.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers describe the product as hydrating and comfortable even with layered skincare, while others (dry-ish/combination, and one who recommends prepping skin with moisturizer beforehand) report it is not hydrating enough on its own.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or generally reactive skin report it does not trigger redness, itching, or flare-ups, unlike other sunscreens they had tried.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation or eye-stinging typical of other sunscreens; one exception describes burning on the face after repeated use.
concerns.spots: Acne-prone reviewers largely report no new breakouts; one reviewer notes it did not cause pimples but made her existing breakouts look more visibly greasy/glossy.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers say this is the rare sunscreen that does not cause new blemishes, with no dissent found on this specific point.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including several with oily or oily/combination skin, report it feels lightweight, non-greasy, and mattifying to glowy rather than oily, though one reviewer isn't sure if it suits oily skin and one found the glow too intense/greasy-looking on her acne.

aspects.libelle: Pills under layered skincare or makeup
Does not sting or burn eyes
Strong dewy glow, sometimes too much

extraits.texte: At first it seemed amazing. Very light with the texture of a serum... But this pills every time I use it, especially when I have on serum and moisturizer underneath. Then with the same serum and moisturizer my other sunscreens don't pill, it's just this one. It's so disappointing because the finish is initially nice! But alas I went off of reviews and this is so overrated and I'm not sure why. Maybe it doesn't pill off if you don't use anything else underneath? Idk but if you're putting sunscreen on bare skin only you're doing it wrong..

Coming from someone who is acne-prone and has sensitive skin this has been the only sunscreen that has not broken me out. It has a nice consistency, not too liquidy or too thick and leaves zero white cast. However, coming from someone who prefers to look more on the glowly side, this is too much glow. My face looks like a disco ball and it lasts all day. Its not the kind of glow i was aiming for. As someone with acne, it made my pimples (and the rest of my face) look more greasy than I actually was, but its the only sunscreen that doesn't cause me to break out. I really wish it wasnt so glowly or if they'd at least come out with a matte version. Otherwise it is a great product!

extraits.titre: Made me actually want to wear spf
extraits.texte: I have very oily and acne-prone skin, so let me tell you, I used to HATE wearing sunscreen with a passion. It always burned my eyes, broke me out, made me look like a glazed donut (in a bad way), or made my makeup pill and slide right off (OR all of the above). I got this sunscreen and IMMEDIATELY fell in love with it. I mean, it was too good to be true. It feels weightless, never burns my eyes, doesn't have a yucky sunscreen smell, and gives me a gorgeous glowy base without making me look oily. PLUS no white cast because it's a gel. I truly cannot say enough good things about this product, and I don't think I could ever go back to another spf. Is it pricey? Yes. Is it worth it? A hundred times yes. I actually look forward to putting this on every day- and I wish I was kidding. It is now my favorite product in my routine. If you haven't found that spf you are in love with yet, TRY THIS ONE.

I have dry skin and need to use many layers of hydration. As a result sunscreen often pills I've used some very high-end highly recommended sunscreens and they just all up and make a mess of my makeup. This is one of the few sunscreens that does not give me that problem goes on clear does not irritate eyes. Highly recommend recommended.

This sunscreen is incredible. I love the way it sits on my skin. It makes my foundation look smooth and beautiful. I love it however, I'm sad to report that it burns my skin. I tried it for about 4 days and every time I put it on my face burns. After reading all the reviews I noticed no one else has had an issue with burning so it might just be might sensitive skin. I'm so sad that I need to return it because I really love it but I can't deal with the burning.

I struggle finding an SPF that works for my skin because I have very dry, acne prone skin. This feels like a serum and doesn't feel heavy at all and it makes my skin glow and I haven't had any breakouts.

extraits.titre: Another Great product from Naked Sundays
extraits.texte: Perfect choice for mature skin, doesn't enhance fine lines and wrinkles and works great under my foundation and on my neck and chest, non greasy
